families.XCH: a plain coin: no family layer, its amount is XCH
families.CAT: the CAT layer: every child is the same CAT and the amount is kept
families.SINGLETON: the singleton top layer: one child goes on, with the same launcher id

types.XCH: XCH held by someone (a key, keys, an offer, a singleton, anyone)
types.REVOCABLE_CAT: a CAT with the revocation layer
types.NFT: a singleton with the NFT state layer
types.DID: a singleton with the DID inner puzzle
types.VAULT: a singleton whose inner puzzle is a MIPS custody tree
types.LAUNCHER: a coin that launches a singleton or a CAT
types.SINGLETON: a singleton with no purpose layer

custodies.KEY: a key signs: the standard puzzle, delegated conditions or puzzle, a BLS or EIP-712 member
custodies.OFFER: settlement payments: whoever fills the offer
custodies.SINGLETON: a singleton spends it (p2 singleton, a vault member)
custodies.ANYONE: anyone can spend it (quoted conditions, the identity puzzle)
custodies.HIDDEN: only the inner puzzle's hash is curried: it shows in the solution
custodies.UNKNOWN: the walk met an unknown layer
